title: SwingSync
description: A attack cooldown HUD for PvP instead of that vanilla cooldown line!
body:
The vanilla attack cooldown indicator is a tiny icon sitting right at your crosshair — the exact spot you need to be watching your opponent. SwingSync moves that information out of the way and turns it into a proper bar on your HUD, so you always know when to swing without breaking your focus.


What it does

It shows your weapon cooldown as a clean horizontal bar that changes color as it charges. Red means not ready, yellow means charging, green means hit. When you hit full charge, the screen edges flash briefly so you feel it even in the middle of a hectic fight.

The bar only shows up when you are actually holding a weapon. Any other time it stays out of your way.


Why it helps

In sword or axe PvP, the difference between a full charge hit and a half charge hit is massive. Most players either stare at the crosshair icon and lose track of their opponent, or ignore it entirely and swing on feel. This gives you a third option — a bar that sits wherever you want on your screen and lets you track your cooldown without taking your eyes off the fight.

It is purely visual. Nothing is automated, nothing is modified. You still swing yourself, the game still runs exactly as normal. It just puts the information somewhere more useful.


Configuration

Press J in game to open the settings. You can move the bar anywhere on your screen, switch between a segmented or solid style, and toggle the flash effect on or off.


Compatibility

Works on any server. The mod only reads cooldown data the game already gives you and displays it differently. It does not touch packets, reach, or any game mechanic.

Requires Fabric API, Cloth Config, and Mod Menu.
